Protect the Kingdom of Dragonfall from the clutches of the Old Ones' Army by defending the Eternia Crystals. Build mighty towers, cunning traps or destructive auras to create powerful and strategic fortifications of your choice. And while you're at it, bring your arcanic, robotic or barbaric heroes and jump on in the action against the hordes in up to 4 player co-op!_ | | Latest Update | | | --- | --- | | | | [![Fairy Tale Update Banner.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/2/2e/Fairy_Tale_Update_Banner.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Fairy_Tale_Update_Banner.png) | | | * [**Major Update: The Fairy Tales Update is now live!**](https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/236110/view/490458677934819058)

* New Hero - The Jester! Magic Staff wielding hero with 4 new abilities & defenses.
* 22 new Shards and 2 new Mods for the Jester.
* New difficulty - Chaos 11! Comes with new shards, mods and a new tier of gear.
* New Chaos II enemy - the Witch.
* New Map and Boss Fight - Carnival Town and the Evil Jester.
* New Jester-themed boss weapons and mods. Awarded from Carnival Town.
* Defender Pass Season 5 is live now! Contains fairy-tale themed costumes (for Mercenary, Countess, Frostweaver & Cyborg), flairs, pet and titles. | | * [**Minor update: The Festival of Hearts (February 12th 2026)**](https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/236110/view/540004614974472237)

* The Festival of Hearts has returned. Visit Violet Marigold's shop again for event rewards.
* Festival of Hearts-exclusive cosmetics and bundles are available to purchase again.
* New seasonal event pet: Angry Cutie - drops in Expeditions.
* A slew of bug fixes and balance changes. | **Latest** ▪ [The Festival of Hearts.
